Gerald Coetzee to Carey, no run, good length delivery outside off, Alex Carey shoulders arms

Aiden Markram to Oliver Peake, no run, flatter delivery that skids on the surface. Oliver Peake tries to cut, but he couldn't get a hand on the pace of the ball. Mistimes it to point
Gerald Coetzee to Carey, no run, good length delivery on middle, defended to the off-side
Gerald Coetzee to Carey, 1 run, Alex Carey hangs on the back foot and punches it though to covers

Gerald Coetzee to Oliver Peake, wide
Aiden Markram to Oliver Peake, 1 run, Oliver Peake taps it wide of cover for another single

Tristan Stubbs to Carey, no run, Alex Carey gets behind the line in defence

Gerald Coetzee to Carey, no run, shortish in length outside off, Alex Carey had to hop to get on top of the bounce and drops it wide of backward point

Nqobani Mokoena to Oliver Peake, no run, good length delivery on middle, defended back to the bowler

Gerald Coetzee to Carey, no run, similar delivery from Coetzee. This time Carey fails to get bat on the ball. Beaten on the outside edge

Gerald Coetzee to Carey, no run, good length delivery on off, Alex Carey blocks it to the off-side
